  WHY: `gh run view --log-failed` is never called and the judge receives no failing-run log tail. Severity disagreement: some reviewers rated this MAJOR; the highest rating was BLOCKER.

  WHY: Consumers copying the example may dispatch runs for operator-step issues that the reusable workflow skips, and the README predicate-parity contract fails.
- tests/test_security_audit_workflow_contract.py:810 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]

  WHY: The assertion fails against the changed clarify predicate, leaving a required CI test failing.
- tests/test_pr_merge_status_guard.py:998-1004 | severity=critical | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The supplied CI run reports `tests-hooks-and-orchestrator` failing, and this test requires the root and workflow-template guard copies, settings, and `CLAUDE.md` to match.
  WHY: The required CI job remains red on the PR head, blocking merge.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:1282-1291 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The root hook lacks the resolved commit SHA assignment and re-verification handling present in its workflow-template copy.
  WHY: The byte-identity contract test fails, contributing to 5 test failures in `tests-hooks-and-orchestrator`.
- scripts/unblock_actions.py:265-286 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: A `reissue` verdict for a PR closes the PR and re-approves its linked issue, but closing an unmerged PR closes linked issues; when there is no linked issue, no replacement issue is created.
  WHY: Linked reissues are cancelled by the close flow, while unlinked PR work is abandoned without a replacement.
- .github/workflows/unblock_judge.yml:33-38 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: All unblock judge runs share one concurrency group, so later pending runs replace earlier pending runs.
  WHY: Cancelled items are treated as busy by the scanner for up to 60 minutes, delaying their redispatch. Severity disagreement: z-ai_glm-5_2 rated this NIT; the highest rating was MAJOR.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:519-540 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: If posting the tracking-issue marker fails after the item verdict comment succeeds, the function returns without executing the verdict operations.
  WHY: The item marker consumes the verdict, so reconciliation can post the missing project marker without ever running the planned action.
- agents.md:1205, 1411 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The documented `STANDALONE_AUTO_DECIDE` prefix and its `LOG_PREFIX.name=` registry entry were removed while `clarify.yml` still emits the prefix.
  WHY: The stable log-prefix contract is broken, leaving downstream log consumers and tooling without the documented registry entry.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:388-393 | severity=low | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The added `escalate` branch labels the failure report but emits no `UNBLOCK_HANDOVER` log line.
  WHY: Operations tooling that greps for `UNBLOCK_HANDOVER` will not detect workflow-failure heal escalations.

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:1878 (last-run diff, "Unblock judge bulk-delete override" step, jq `scan` expression) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The removed `| .[0]` leaves `$used` as an array of arrays, so its scalar comment-ID lookup never detects a spent marker.
  WHY: The one-shot bulk-delete threshold override can be reused on every subsequent implementation run.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:558 (last-run diff, `unblock_ask_model` function, run-ID jq expression) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The removed `| .[0]` leaves `scan()` results as arrays, so `run_id` is not a bare numeric string.
  WHY: The shell test rejects the run ID and `gh run view "${run_id}" --log-failed` is never executed, leaving the failing run's log tail empty.
- scripts/unblock_actions.py:279-286 (`plan` function, `reissue` verdict for PRs) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: A PR reissue closes the PR and re-approves the linked issue; an unmerged PR close closes linked issues, and an unlinked PR gets no replacement issue.
  WHY: Reapproval is undone for linked issues, while an unlinked PR is closed without replacement tracking.
- .github/workflows/unblock_judge.yml (jobs.unblock-judge.concurrency.group) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: All judge runs share one concurrency group with only one running and one pending slot, so later dispatches replace pending runs.
  WHY: Items whose runs are cancelled are treated as busy for up to 60 minutes, delaying resolution.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:519-537 (verdict posting order and project-ledger reconciliation, last-run diff) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: If posting the tracking-issue marker fails after the item verdict is recorded, the function returns without running the verdict operations.
  WHY: The verdict is consumed for that failure fingerprint, and reconciliation does not run the missed action.
- agents.md:1205 (prose listing) and 1411 (LOG_PREFIX.name= registry), last-run diff | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `STANDALONE_AUTO_DECIDE` was removed from the documentation and registry while `clarify.yml` still emits it.
  WHY: Tooling that reconciles emitted prefixes with the documented registry reports a missing entry.
